Description
Outdoor appliances need higher test levels While indoor equipment is “protected” by buildings and installed protective devices, outdoor appliances are often subjected to more intensive EMC disturbances. Therefore the test requirements for outdoor equipment are generally higher. The Teseq NSG 3060 series covers basic surge and transients testing for outdoor equipment as required in ANSI IEEE C62.41 & 45, ITU-T K. and other dedicated product standards:
Telecom Appliances
Solar Panels
Windmills
Electric Vehicle Charging Stations
Surge Protection Devices
Smart Grid Appliances
Power Distribution
Military & Defense
Teseq’s new NSG 3060 is an easy-to-use multifunction generator that simulates electromagnetic interference effects for immunity testing in conformity with international, national and manufacturers’ standards including the latest IEC/EN standards. The NSG 3060 system is designed to fulfill conducted EMC test requirements for CE mark testing and ANSI C62.41, including Combination Wave Surge (6.6 kV), Electrical Fast Transient (EFT) pulses (4.8 kV), Ring Wave (6.6 kV), and Power Quality Testing (PQT). Expansion capabilities enable the system to be configured for a much broader range of applications including Telecom Surge 10/700 and Magnetic Field tests.
Featuring an innovative modular design, the NSG 3060 is a versatile system that can be configured for basic testing needs and expanded to meet the needs of sophisticated test laboratories. Teseq’s well proven “Master-Slave” architecture enables individual pulse modules to be calibrated separately, with calibration data and correction factors stored on the slave controller. New modules can be easily installed with no need to return the entire system for calibration.
Depending on your exact testing needs, different models are available to ensure the NSG 3060 is configured to your exact testing requirements. Contact TestWorld today for the best price on a Teseq NSG 3060 6kV Conducted Immunity Generator for CE Mark Testing.

Common Configurations available for the Teseq NSG 3060:
Teseq NSG 3060-1: Mainframe NSG 3060 with CWM 3650, RWM 3652 and FTM 3425 including CDN 3061-C61 and PQM 3403 includes WIN 3000 basic software and traceable calibration certificate.
Teseq NSG 3060-2: Mainframe NSG 3060 with CWM 3650 and FTM 3425 including CDN 3061-C61 and PQM 3403 includes WIN 3000 basic software and traceable calibration certificate.
Teseq NSG 3060-ANSI: Mainframe NSG 3060 with CWM 3650, RWM 3652 and FTM 3425. Multi-function generator for Surge Combination Wave, Ring Wave, and EFT/Burst, for IEC and ANSI C62.41 & 45 testing. Includes single phase 16A CDN. Also includes WIN 3000 basic software and traceable calibration certificate.
Teseq NSG 3060-ITU: Multi-function generator for Surge Combination Wave, Telecom Surge, and EFT/Burst, for IEC and ITU-T.K series testing. Includes single phase 16 A CDN.
Configure Transient Modules for your Teseq NSG 3060:
CWM 3650: Combination Wave Module 1.2/50us to 6.6kV
RWM 3652: Ringwave Module 0.5us/100kHz to 6.6kV
FTM 3425: Fast Transient (Burst) Module to 4.8kV
TSM 3751: Telecom Wave module 10/700us to 7.7 kV
NSG 3060-TSEXT-EPO: Extension unit with 10/700us telecom surge module for control by NSG 3040 or NSG 3060 system. Includes interface cable, user manual and traceable calibration certificate.
Coupling / Decoupling Network Options for your Teseq NSG 3060:
CDN 3061-C16-PQM: Coupling network 1-ph, 265V, 16A automatic (combined burst, surge and interrupt)
CDN 3061-C16: Coupling network 1-ph, 265V, 16A automatic (combined burst and surge)
CDN 3061-S16: Coupling network 1-ph, 265V, 16A automatic (surge only)
CDN 3063-C32: Coupling network 3-ph, 480V, 32A automatic (combined burst and surge)
CDN 3063-B32: Coupling network 3-ph, 480V, 32A automatic (burst only)
CDN 3063-S32: Coupling network 3-ph, 480V, 32A automatic (surge only)
CDN 3063-S63: Coupling network 3-ph, 480V, 63A automatic (surge only)
CDN 3063-S100: Coupling network 3-ph, 480V, 100A automatic (surge only)
CDN 3083-S100: Surge only 100A 3-phase coupling / decoupling network, 620V with NSG 3060, 440V with NSG 3040 for surges to 8kV, manual operation, requires INA 3080, 3084, 3085 or CDN 3061-x16. Traceable calibration certificate.
CDN 3083-S200: Surge only 200A 3-phase coupling / decoupling network, 620V with NSG 3060, 440V with NSG 3040 for surges to 8kV, manual operation, requires INA 3080, 3084, 3085 or CDN 3061-x16. Traceable calibration certificate.
CDN 3083-B100: (CDN 163) EFT only 3-phase coupling / decoupling network, 400/690V, 100A, couples to all lines simultaneously per IEC 61000-4-4 ed 2: 2004.
CDN 3083-B200: EFT only 3-phase coupling / decoupling network, 400/690V, 200A, couples to all lines simultaneously per IEC 61000-4-4 ed 2: 2004.
CDN 117-M: CDN for unbalanced 2-wire Data Lines includes coax cables for Modula and NSG 3xxx
CDN 118-M: CDN for 2-pairs of balanced Data Lines includes coax cables for Modula and NSG 3xxx
CDN-HSS-2: New CDN for surging up to 8 lines of high speed balanced Data Lines to 1000MHz according to draft EN 61000-4-5 with 1.2/50us combination wave pulses up to 2kV. Coupling is via 40Ω resistors in series with a capacitor, max surge current 50A
Additional Accessories for CE Mark Testing with the Teseq NSG 3060:
CDN 3425: Data Line Capacitive Coupling Clamp without safety interlock, replaces CDN 8014
INA 3825: Data Line EFT capacitive coupling clamp cover w/safety interlock
INA 6501: Step transformer 0%,40%,70%,80%,100% for switched voltage variations (manual setting of dip level), 16A.
INA 6502: Program controlled step transformer 0%,40%,70%, 80%, 100% for switched voltage variations (manual preset), 16A. Fully automatic operation via Win3000 software.
INA 701: 1m x 1m magnetic field coil for power line magnetic fields up to 4A/m, requires MFO 6501or MFO 6502, includes cable to MFO 650x
INA 702: 1m x 1m magnetic field coil for power line magnetic fields up to 40A/m, requires MFO 6501 or MFO 6502, includes cable to MFO 650x
INA 703: 1m x 1m magnetic field coil for power line magnetic fields up to 120A/m, with MFO 6501 or MFO 6502, or up to 330A/m with NSG 1007 series source. Requires INA 3251 cable.
MFO 6501: Stand-alone generator unit for power line frequency magnetic tests with antennas INA 701 or INA 702. Requires user supplied Ampmeter.
MFO 6502 Interface and amplifier unit for power line frequency magnetic tests with antennas INA 701 or INA 702. Fully automatic operation via Win3000 software.
